output.summary: A perennial herb native to western North America, from southern Alaska and British Columbia south to Utah and California. Its hand-shaped leaves have numerous leaflets, while wild plants usually bear tall spikes of blue-to-purple flowers. Newer garden hybrids are highly poisonous and should never be eaten.
output.edibilityNote: Newer garden hybrids are highly poisonous and should never be eaten; low-alkaloid cultivars mentioned are bred for animal fodder.
